name: GhostSeparator
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostSeparator. Same behavioral props; no extra visual props. Importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes styles to this instance. Hand-written until GHO-13 generates manifests.

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered root element, forwarded to the unstyled GhostSeparator. Omit to get hr when horizontal and div when vertical. li is for list-shaped menus.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Forwards presentational semantics to the unstyled GhostSeparator.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Axis of the line, forwarded to the unstyled GhostSeparator.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The divider element inside the display:contents themed scope.
